source_grounding.by_design_evidence: Missing-collection branch is deliberately engineered: it holds collection_create_lock (comment explains race-with-creation hazard), cleans an orphaned on-disk directory, and returns structured Ok(false) — the boolean is a first-class part of the fn signature Result<bool, StorageError> and is surfaced in the API response as the DOCUMENTED result:boolean field. Same never-404 convention as sibling endpoint GET /collections/{name}/exists (raw_knowledge L140: 'never 404 for missing collection (existence expressed in body)'). Contrast: update_collection (L160-162) uses get_collection_unchecked(...).await? which DOES propagate NotFound -> 404 for missing collections, showing the codebase distinguishes the two endpoints' missing-resource semantics on purpose.
